steps.t: Save your client's brand rules once.
steps.d: Voice, do, do not and product images are captured from the brief, so each new piece starts from the same rules.

steps.t: Generate several drafts from one brief.
steps.d: Four takes come from the same rules, so your client chooses between options instead of waiting for a redo.

steps.t: Have a person check every draft.
steps.d: Labels, hands, claims and brand fit are reviewed by a person and fixed before the piece goes anywhere near your client.

steps.t: Hand over files and a usage note.
steps.d: Final files arrive in your folder structure with a plain note of what is AI-made, so you can disclose it as your client needs.
